༄༅/ /kun slong 'chos tshul sogs nyams len gyi skor bshad pa blo gsal dga' byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun slong 'chos tshul sogs nyams len gyi skor bshad pa blo gsal dga' byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal las 'khrungs pa'i sku/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos phung sgrogs pa'i gsung*/ /rab 'byams shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i thugs/ /zla med ston pa shākya'i gtso der 'dud/ /khyod kyis ji snyed gsungs pa'i chos tshul kun/ /gdul bya smin grol lam la 'god phyir te/ /gzhan don mi 'gyur mdzad pa khyod la med/ /de slad phan mdzad skyabs kyi dam par nges/ /mgon des bstan pa'i mngon mtho nges legs lam/ /rnam grangs mang yang gdul bya'i dbang po dang*/ /'tsham par gsungs pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam/ /'dir ni tshul de gzhir byas bshad par bya/ /de yang blo ldan don du gnyer ba dag gis nyin zhag phrug gcig la dge sbyor byed tshul dang*/ kun slong 'chos tshul bcas dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngag ma zlog par cung zad 'chad pa la/ spyir nyin zhag phrug gcig la dge sbyor gang byed rang gi 'dod pa ltar 'jug pa yin gyi logs su dgos pa ma yin la/ khyad par du mdo phyogs ltar na lam rim nas bshad pa bzhin dang*/ sngags phyogs la de'i steng du rgyud sde bzhi po gang yin pa'i lha de dang de'i mngon rtogs bsgom pa dang*/ bla med la ni gsang bde 'jigs sogs kyi bskyed rdzogs gnyis lta bu rang gang mos pa de la 'jug dgos pa yin gyi/ de dag bzhag nas gzhan gyis bsgrigs pa tsam la 'jug par ga la rigs/ 'on kyang nyams len bsdus pa man ngag gi thog tu 'bab pa yin pas tshul de shes par bya zhing*/ de'i tshe kha ton gzhan dang*/ gtor ma gtong ba dang*/ bza' btung gi cho ga ji ltar bya ba sogs kyang skabs bstun gyis bya'o/ /de ltar yin kyang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kun gyi gzhi ni/ dkon mchog la skyabs su song ba'i skyabs 'gro yin te/ 'di bcos min zhig yod na ni chos phyogs gang byas kyang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos su 'gyur zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs pa dang*/

sdom pa'i rten byed pa dang*/ mngon mtho dang der ma zad/ nges legs 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ / 'on kyang tshe 'di'i nad sel ba lta bu tsam gyi ched du dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can min gyi/ phyi ma ngan song las thar 'dod dang*/ 'khor ba las thar 'dod dang*/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi ched du skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro rnams ni snga ma las phyi ma khyad par du 'phags te/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can yin no/ /de dag rang don tsam la dmigs pa las gzhan don du dmigs nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni ches khyad par du 'phags so/ /de yang tshig gis skyabs su mcha'o zhes brjod pa ni rjod byed tshig gi skyabs 'gro yin yang*/ skyabs 'gro dngos ni ltos pa blo'i skyabs 'gro yin te/ skyabs la snying thag pa nas blo bkal te re ltos 'cha' ba'o/ /blo de shin tu brtan po zhig 'byung ba la las 'bras la yid ches pa dang*/ skyabs kyi khyad par rnams gzhung chen mo dag las bshad pa ltar shes dgos shing*/ de dag rigs pa'i sgo nas nges pa la dbu tshad kyi rigs pa legs po shes dgos so/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam la rim par blo sbyong ba'i nang du kun slong 'chos tshul 'dus kyang*/ kun slong spy-i bye brag la sbyar te bshad na/ bya ba mchog dman gang yin kyang thog mar de'i ched du bya ba de dang de bya'o snyam pa rnams ni rgyu'i kun slong dang*/ bya ba de dang de la 'jug dus kyi kun slong ni dus kyi kun slong yin no/ /dper mtshon na thog mar srog gcod 'dod skyes pa dang*/ srog gcod pa'i dus kyi kun slong lta bu dang*/ de'i phyir srog gcod mi bya'o snyam pa dang*/ de nas srog gcod mi byed pa'i dus kyi kun slong lta bu'o/ /'di la phyin phan 'dod kyi bsam pas sbyin pa gtang bar bya'o/ /snyam du thog mar skyes pa'i phan 'dod de kun slong gtso bo yin zhing*/

phyi ma dam bcar yang 'gyur la/ sbyin pa gtong ba'i dus kyi gtong sems ni kun slong las skyes pa yin gyi kun slong dngos min yang*/ de'i bar skabs dag tu dus kyi kun slong 'jug tshul yang shes par bya ste tshul khrims sogs gzhan la yang de ltar ro/ /kun slong la rang don kho na'i dbang du gyur pa dang*/ gzhan don kho na'i dbang du gyur pa dang*/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don gyi dbang du gyur pa'i kun slong gsum yod cing*/ de la ni tshe 'di dang phyi ma gnyis po re re dang*/ thun mong du dmigs pa'ang 'byung ngo*/ /gzhan yang*/ kun slong la dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum yod de/ dang po gnyis dge mi dge'i las la 'jug 'dod kyi rgyu dus kyi kun slong rnams dang*/ gsum pa ni byis pa'i rtse las kyi kun slong lta bu sogs dge mi dge gang yang min pa'i kun slong rnams so/ /kun slong la ni gong gi skyabs 'gro'i skabs ltar tshe 'di dang*/ ngan song las thar 'dod dang*/ thar pa thob 'dod dang*/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi kun slong rnams su yod de/ snga ma las phyi ma ni khyad par can no/ /spyir dge ba byed 'dod kyi kun slong rnams dge ba dang mi dge byed 'dod kyi kun slong rnams mi dge ba yin kyang*/ gzhan phan gyi bsam pas mi dge ba'i las 'ga' zhig byed pa'i kun slong dge ba dang*/ phrag dog 'gran sems kyis dge ba sgrub pa lta bu la kun slong mi dge ba 'byung srid do/ /des na kun slong khyad par can gyi sgo nas dge sbyor la 'jug cing*/ 'jug pa'i go rim ni mtha' gcig tu 'di nas bya bar ma nges kyang dang po skyabs 'gro nas 'jug cing mthar bsngo smon byed dgos pa 'dra ste/ phran tshegs la ni nges pa med do/ /'dir phyogs gcig gi dbang du byas te bshad na/ phyi ma'i don la dmigs pa'i kun slong khyad par can gyi ngang nas nang par langs te/ ltung bshags la sogs phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa'i skor rnams rgyas bsdus ci rigs byas pa'i mjug tu/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med rnams spyi ltar bya ste/ de yang dkar chos khyad par can gzhan rnams kyi gzhi yin pas sngon du 'byung gi chos chung ba'i dbang gis min no/ /de yang skyabs 'gro ni theg pa gsum gyi dkar chos gzhan thams cad bskyed pa dang gnas pa dang spel ba'i gzhi yin la/ tshad med rnams ni theg pa chen po'i chos gzhan 'byung ba dang*/ sems bskyed de ni theg pa chen po'i chos gzhan thams cad 'dzin cing spel ba'i gzhi khyad par can yin no/ /byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes na yon tan gzhan yod dam med kyang theg chen du tshud par 'jog cing*/ de min na yon tan gzhan brgya phrag yod kyang theg chen par 'jog mi nus pas theg chen par byed pa'i khyad chos kyang yin no/ /des na sems bskyed lta zhog skyabs 'gro dang tshad med rnams kyang nyams len gyi gtso bo yin pas/ de dag tshig tsam zhig byas nas dge sbyor phran tshegs la 'bad pa ni gnad chung ste shes dgos so/ /gsang sngags kyi nyams len rnams ni spyir theg pa chen po'i nyams len yin kyang*/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod dang theg chen sems bskyed kyis ma zin na theg chen gyi chos su mi 'gyur bar lam rim sogs las bshad cing*/ theg chen gyi spyod par yang mi 'gro la/ sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i sgo nas phyin drug dang bslab gsum dang rim gnyis bsgom pa lta bu lta ci/ tha na dud 'gro la zan chang gcig byin na'ang rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob pa'i grangs su 'gro zhing*/ des ma zin na stong gsum rin po ches bkang ste sbyin pa byin kyang rgyal sras kyi spyod par mi 'gro bar lam rim las bshad do/ /nges 'byung thar ba la byed kyang*/ nges 'byung gi blo ni 'khor ba las thar bar 'dod pa'i blo zhig la byed cing*/ 'khor ba las thar bar byed pa'i thabs dngos ni/ bslab pa gsum dang khyad par du shes rab kyi bslab pa yin te/

stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa dngos sam/ rjes mthun tsam yin yang de skyes pa tsam gyis ni/ thar pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin pas grogs gzhan gyis zin pa la ma ltos te/ 'phags pa lhas/ bsod nams chung ngus chos 'di la/ /the tshom za bar yang mi 'gyur/ /the tshom zos pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /srid pa hrul por byed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang theg chen gyi spyod par 'gyur ba la ni sems bskyed la rag las pa yin te/ spyod pa gzhan rnams dang 'dra'o/ /ji skad du/ zhi sgo gnyis su med pa rten 'brel lam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zhi ba thar pa thob byed kyi thabs thams cad kyi gtso bo sgo gcig pu ni/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba yin pas de tshul khrims kyis zin zhing bsgoms pas thar pa thob par 'gyur gyi/ de med na yon tan gzhan gang gis kyang thar pa thob mi nus te/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gal te bdag med chos la so sor rtog /so sor der brtag gal te sgom byed na/ /thar pa mya ngan 'das 'thob 'bras bu'i rgyu/ /rgyu gzhan gang gis de ni zhir mi 'gyur*/ /zhes dang*/ mdo sdud pa las kyang*/ dmus long dmigs bu med pa bye ba khrag khrig rnams/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bus mtshon te mang yang ma bris/ des na bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ sems bskyed gnyis yod na rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi gtso bo gnyis yod par 'jog gi de gnyis dngos sam phyogs mthun tsam yang med na yon tan gyi gtso bo dang bral ba yin pas bsam pa gal che zhing*/ de gnyis kyis sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang*/ yon tan gzhan sgrub pa 'dra ba bzlas brjod gzhan la med do/ /'on kyang sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs su rgyal bas stobs bzhi'i bshags pa gsungs pa ltar 'bad dgos shing*/ de la rten gyi stobs ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang tshad med bzhi lta bu dang*/ sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni 'gyod sems kyis nyes pa bshags pa dang*/

slar ldog pa'i stobs ni phyin chad nyes pas de lta bu mi byed pa yin la/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs la ni bzlas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mtshan brjod pa dang*/ stong nyid ston pa'i mdo sde zab mo 'don pa sogs mang zhing*/ de dag gis kyang sdig ltung mang po sbyong nus yang*/ gtso bor gyur pa ni bdag med kyi don rtogs pa ste/ 'di bsgoms na sdig ltung rtsad nas gcod nus kyi/ gzhan rnams kyis ni de tsam mi nus so/ /las dang po pa stong nyid rtogs pa'i nus pa med pa'am/ yod pas kyang sdig ltung sbyong ba'i thabs rgyal bas gsungs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs/ yig brgya/ rnam pa rgyal ma'i gzungs sogs gzungs sngags khyad par can gzhan dang*/ ltung bshags dang*/ thar chen nas 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mtshan dang*/ khyad par du mi 'khrugs pa dang sman bla'i mtshan yang yang brjod na legs so/ /gro nas sran ma sogs sa bon sna tshogs btab pa las rang rang gi 'bras bu gang yin pa de gegs gzhan med na ma nor bar 'byung gi nor nas 'byung ba mi srid pa de bzhin du phyi'i dngos po'i sa bon gzhan las kyang rang gi 'bras bu gang yin ma 'khrul bar 'byung la/ nang rang gzhan gyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i las dkar nag gnyis so so las rnam smin gyi 'bras bu so sor ma nor bar 'byung bas bshags sdom gal che'o/ /mi dge ba'i las kyis ni ngan 'gror skye zhing*/ ngan 'gror skye ba ni 'khor bar skye ba yin pas ngan 'gro las thar pa ni 'khor ba bye brag pa las thar bar 'jog kyang 'khor ba las thar bar 'jog mi nus te/ 'khor ba las thar zhes pa ni 'khor ba spyi las thar pa'i sgo nas 'jog cing*/ 'khor ba las thar 'dod mtshan nyid pa skyes pa yang 'khor ba spyi las thar 'dod skyes pa'i sgo nas 'jog gi 'khor ba bye brag pa ngan song las thar 'dod yod pa tsam gyis mi chog go /'khor ba spyi las thar 'dod rnam dag skye ba la ngan 'gror ma zad/

bde 'gro'i sdug bsngal skye rga na 'chis bsdus pa rnams bsams nas de las thar 'dod skyes pa na 'khor ba spyi las thar 'dod skyes pa yin no/ /lha mi'i skye ba 'dzin pa la snying rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis skye ba 'dzin pa dang*/ de yang gzhan don khyad par can byed pa dang*/ chos sgrub pa'i ched du bsam bzhin skye ba 'dzin pa yod kyang de ni 'khor ba'i gnas su skyes pa yin kyang 'khor ba dngos gnas su skyes bar 'jog mi nus so/ /'khor ba dngos gnas pa ni las nyon gyi dbang gis nying 'tshams sbyang ba zhig la 'jog ste/ da dung zhi ba cha mang ngo*/ /'khor ba'i gnas su skye ba blangs pa tsam gyis ni 'khor bar skyes par mi 'jog ste/ dper na rgyal bu gzhon nu don grub lta bu dang*/ bsrong btsan sgam po dang*/ rje rin po che lta bu'o/ /de la 'khor ba'i rgyu dang*/ 'khor ba dngos dang*/ 'khor ba'i gnas dang*/ 'khor bar 'khor mkhan rnams so sor phyed par bya'i/ thams cad gcig tu 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba'am dang po'i rgyu ni ma rig pa dang*/ 'khor bar 'phen byed la las dang 'grub byed la nyon mongs can gyi sred len gnyis yod de/ khyad par shes dgos shing*/ las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khor bar 'khor tshul la zhib na mang yang*/ gtso bo'i dbang du byas na rgyu kun 'byung bden pa las nyon gyi dbang gis/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal gsum dang ldan pa'i 'khor bar skye ba blangs pa ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bden pa'i phung po grub pa dang*/ yang nyon mongs ma rig pa'i dbang gis zag bcas kyi las dkar nag gnyis bsags pa la sred len gnyis kyis gsos btab ste/ srid las nus pa mthu can du gyur pa'i sgo nas rnam shes phyi mar bde 'gro ngan 'gro gang rung du nying 'tshams sbyar nas ming gzugs skye mched sogs rim gyis 'grub par 'gyur zhing*/ de'i steng du reg tshor dang rga shi sogs kyang 'grub par 'gyur te/

yan lag bcu gnyis kyi 'khor ba'i 'jug rim mtshon tsam mo/ /mdor na rje'i nyams mgur las/ sdug bden nyes dmigs bsams la ma 'bad na/ /thar pa don gnyer ji bzhin mi skye zhing*/ /kun 'byung 'khor ba'i 'jug rim ma bsams na/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod tshul mi shes pas/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar rgyu kun 'byung dang 'bras bu sdug bden gyi khyad par rnams lam rim ltar shes pa gal che'o/ / mdor na de ltar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes te 'khor ba las thar 'dod skyes pa ni nges 'byung skyes pa dang*/ thar pa don gnyer kyang skyes pa yin no/ /de skyes pa tsam yang legs mod/ de tsam gyis mi chog gi 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa rtsad nas gcod cing spong ba la gong du brjod pa ltar bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab bskyed dgos te/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum las/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab mi ldan na/ / nges 'byung byang chub sems la goms byas kyang*/ srid pa'i tsa ba gcod par mi nus pas/ /de phyir rten 'brel rtogs pa'i thabs la 'bad/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ nyams mgur las kyang*/ shes rab zab mo'i de nyid lta ba'i mig /srid pa'i rtsa ba drung nas 'byin pa'i lam/ / gsung rab kun las bsngags pa'i yon tan gter/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas shes pa gal che zhing*/ 'dir lta ba'i rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad na mang du dogs pas mtshon tsam ni/ ma dros pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes/ /de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /rkyen la rag las gang de stong par bshad/ /gang zhig stong nyid shes de bag yod yin/ zhes dang*/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang*/ /de nyid stong pa nyid du bshad/ /de ni brten nas gdags pa ste/ /de nyid dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /gang phyir rten 'byung ma yin pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin pa/ /de phyir stong pa ma yin pa'i/

/chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no zhes dang*/ 'phags pa lhas/ brten nas 'byung ba gang yin pa/ /'di kun rang dbang mi 'gyur ro/ /'di kun rang dbang med pa ste/ /des na bdag ni yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ de dag gi don rjes/ gang gang rkyen la rag las pa/ /de de rang bzhin gyis stong zhes/ /gsungs pa 'di las ya mtshan pa'i/ /legs 'doms tshul ni ci zhig yod/ /ces gsungs te/ chos thams cad kyi steng du dgag bya bden grub 'gog pa'i rigs pa kun gyi gnas bsdus pa'o/ /de'i don bsdu na phy-i nang gi dngos po 'di thams cad rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las byung la/ de rnams dang chos thams cad kyang rang rang gi cha shas tshogs pa'i steng du btags shing*/ cha shas rnams kyang rang rang gi cha shas kyi steng du rtog pas btags nas tha snyad du yod par 'jog gi cha shas la ma bltos par rang dbang gis ma grub pas bden par ma grub ces pa'o/ /gdags gzhi cha shas la ma ltos par grub pa zhig byung na bden par grub pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa dang*/ rang dbang gis grub par 'gyur na de ni mi srid de/ dper na/ bum pa lta bu ni rang gi mchu zhabs lto ba sogs kyi steng du btags pa dang*/ shing rta lta bu rang gi yan lag tshogs pa'i steng du btags pa dang*/ khang pa lta bu rang gi cha shas ka gdung sogs tshogs pa'i steng du btags pa dang*/ rang gi lus 'di yan lag tshogs pa'i steng du btags pa dang*/ mgo lta bu thod spyi 'gram pa sogs tshogs pa la btags pa dang*/ bdag kyang phung po lnga'am/ lus sems tshogs pa la btags pa dang*/ sems kyang rnam shes sems byung dang 'du byed sogs tshogs pa'i steng du btags pa dang ri lta bu sa rdul tshogs pa dang*/ chu bo ni chu rdul phra mo tshogs pa'i steng du btags/ rdul phran rnams kyang gcig la gcig brten dang phan tshun ltos nas bzhag pa'i btags yod ming rkyang tsam ste rang dbang gis grub pa rdul tsam yang med do/

/de ltar rang dbang gis ma grub pas rang bzhin gyis stong zhing*/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa la 'khor 'das la sogs pa'i bya byed thams cad 'thad cing bzhag tu yod la/ rang bzhin gyis grub na bsgyur mi rung bas bya byed thams cad mi rung ste/ rjes/ rang bzhin gyis ni stong pa la/ /bya byed 'thad pa mi 'gal zhing*/ /de las ldog par mthong ba na/ /stong la bya ba mi rung zhing*/ /bya dang bcas la stong med pas/ /nyam nga'i g.yang du ltung bar bzhed/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i btags yod ming rkyang sgyu ma lta bu'i don la las 'bras sogs 'khor 'das kyi rnam gzhag thams cad 'thad pa la rigs pa yang dag gis nges shes 'drongs pa'i bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag de ji lta ba bzhin 'jog dka' yang shes na legs so/ /byang chub kyi sems ni theg chen sems bskyed la 'jog cing*/ 'di zhib tu bshad na mang yang bsdu na/ sems can thams cad bde ba la 'god 'dod kyi byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal las skyob 'dod kyi snying rje gnyis sems bskyed kyi rgyur nges par dgos shing*/ de gnyis kyis kun nas bslangs te sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rang nyid kyang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa tshig gis brjod pa tsam ma yin par/ sems thog tu bcos min zhig skyes na byang chub tu sems bskyed par 'jog go /byams snying rje gnyis dang lhag tu sems bskyed dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab 'di gnyis la phan yon rgya cher mdo las bshad pa mthong ste zung 'brel du bsgom rgyu byung na lam stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can bsgom pa dang 'bras bu chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /nyams len gyi snying po bsdu na bslab gsum yin la/ 'di gsum phyin drug tu 'du ba yin te/ tshul khrims ni de'i tshul khrims su 'du la/

ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang shes rab kyi bslab pa gnyis ni phar phyin tha ma gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i phyir ro/ /des na phyin drug mtshon tsam ni/ sbyin pa la zang zing dang chos kyi sbyin pa gnyis yod cing*/ sbyin rgyu'i dngos po ni sbyin bya'i rdzas yin gyi sbyin pa min te/ sbyin pa ni gtong sems la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /zang zing gi sbyin pas ni longs spyod 'grub/ tshul khrims la nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims sogs gsum yod cing*/ mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i tshul khrims sogs te so sor phye na mang ngo*/ /byed las ni mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang 'grub bo/ /bzod pa la yang sdug bsngal dang len sogs gsum ste/ gzugs bzang po 'grub po/ /brtson 'grus la yang gsum ste/ dge ba'i las thams cad 'grub bo/ /bsam gtan gyis sems zhi bar gnas pa dang*/ shes rab kyis ni sems rnam par grol bar byed de/ 'di gnyis la yang gsum gsum du dbye bar bya ste mtshon tsam mo/ /phan yon de ltar mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde/ /bzod pas mdangs ldan brtson pas brjid/ /bsam gtan gyis zhi blo yis grol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo sdud pa las kyang bshad do/ /spyir rgyas sras kyi spyod pa dpag tu med pa yod kyang*/ bsdu na/ 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po'i spyod pa'i rjes su slob par 'dod pa'i bsam pas bsngo smon rgyun du byas na khyad che bar nges so/ /dge ba che chung gang byas kyang mjug tu rdzogs byang du bsgyur ba'i bsngo smon bya ste/ bsngo smon khyad par can gyis ni dge rtsa chung ngu chen por 'gro zhing che chung gang yin kyang gnas pa dang*/ 'phel ba dang mi zad pa sogs su 'gyur ro/ /da ni nyams su len tshul gzhan cung zad bshad par bya ste/ 'di la mang yang tshul gcig ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum dang*/ de nas/

rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar sed+ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis spras shing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil dkrung gis 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su byams mgon sku mdog dmar ser chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya can/ g.yon klu shing gi sdong po spy-i blugs kyis mtshan pa 'dzin cing*/ dbu la byang chub mchod rten gyis spras pa/ g.yon du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser/ g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri dang*/ g.yon sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ mdun du spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma gnyis shel phreng dang pad dkar 'dzin pa/ gsum ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas sbras shing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rgyab tu rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag po sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i stobs kyis bzhugs la/ g.yas phyogs su thogs med sku mched la sogs pa rgya chen spyod rgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ g.yon phyogs su klu sgrub yab sras la sogs pa zab mo lta rgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ mtha' bskor du yi dam lha tshogs thams cad dang sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ de dag gi steng gi char sed+ge'i khri la rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang ste/ mtha' bskor du in+d+ra bho dhi sa ra ha lū dril nag gsum dang lā li ta la sogs pa nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/

de thams cad kyi spyi bor auṃ/ mgrin pa ā: thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas thub dbang rdo rje 'chang chen po la sogs pa'i dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ /༈ dzaḥ thugs rje'i bdag nyid thub dbang rdo rje 'chang/ /byams mgon 'jam dbyangs phyag rdor spyan ras gzigs/ /shing rta che sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs/ / spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /rgyud sde bzhi 'brel yi dam lha tshogs dang*/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung rgya mtsho bcas/ /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs brtser dgongs bzhugs su gsol/ /badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang rang gi dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ cung zad rgyas par na/ thub dbang rdo rje 'chang chen po byams 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs gsang ba'i bdag po la sogs pa rgyal sras brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan gsum lam bdun sogs dang*/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad dang rgyud sde bzhi 'brel gyi yi dam lha tshogs thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan gsum sogs dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang*/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshaugs rnams dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang skyabs gnas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa sngar bzhin no/ /'dir mchod do skyabs su mchi'o zhes sbyar yang mi 'gal zhing*/ de nas/ bdag pos bzung ba dang ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs rnams sa dang bar snang gi khyon thams cad gang zhing*/ mgron rnams mnyes par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ auṃ ā:hūṃ/ lan gsum/ auṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ nas/ khaṃḥ lan gsum/ grub na mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum brjod par bya ste/

'di mchod pa byin gyis rlob pa dang 'bul byed kyang yin no/ /de nas/ phyogs bcu na bdag pos bzung ba dang ma bzung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dang*/ 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun/ bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad/ gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla dang bcas pa'i mchod tshogs ji snyed mchis pa kun dang*/ bdag gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa thams cad kyang skyabs mgon dam pa khyed rnams la 'bul zhing mchod do/ /lan gsum mam gcig sa gzhi spos kyi ma'am/ bdag gzhan lus ngag ma gnyis sam gang rung*/ spro na bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya'o/ /ma grub na/ mchod do zhes pa'i mjug tu/ bdag cag gis thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar bgyis pa'i mi dge ba bcu dang*/ mtshams ma mchis pa lnga dang*/ sdom pa gsum gyi bcas pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ mi khom pa brgyad kyi gnas su skye bar 'gyur ba'i nyes pa'i tshogs ci ma chis pa thams cad khyed rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo/ / bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /mi sbed do/ /slan chad kyang mi bgyid do/ /zhes pa'ang lan gsum mam gcig/༈ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi mdzad pa phun sum tshogs pa dang de dag gi bsod nams kyi phung po dang*/ nyan rang 'phags tshogs rnams dang*/rang gzhan thams cad kyis bgyis pa'i rnam dkar gyi legs tshogs kun la yum gyi mdo dang*/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo las ji ltar rjes su yi rang bar mdzad pa de ltar rjes su yi rang zhing dga' bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul lo/ /rgyal dang de sras thams cad kyang mya ngan las mi 'da' bar sems can gyi don du rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ 'dis mtshon te dus gsum du bsags pa'i rnam dkar gyi phung po ci mchis pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdus te sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/

/de yang 'phags pa kun tu bzang po dang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas ji ltar bsngo bar mdzad pa de bzhin du dang*/ de dag gi rjes su slob pa dang*/ rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /zhes sogs kyis kyang bsngo te/ de dag ni bsngo ba bla na med par bshad do/ /de rnams tshigs bcad kyis bsdu bar 'dod na/༈ skyabs mgon zla med thub dbang rdo rje 'chang*/ /sems dpa' bzhi dang shing rta chen po sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyan rang 'phags tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ / bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas/ /skyabs gnas mgron du spyan drangs thams cad la/ /bdag ni rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang*/ /mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo sogs/ /nyer spyod mchod pa'i tshogs rnams thams cad 'bul/ /'dod yon rin chen bdun dang bkra shis brgyad/ /gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla bkod pa'i rgyan/ /kun bzang smon lam las byung mchod sprin dang*/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs bcas te 'bul/ /thog ma med nas bgyis pa'i mi dge'i las/ /ji snyed mchis pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags/ /rang gzhan kun gyis bskrun pa'i rnam dkar la/ /bsam pa thag pas rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /'gro kun don du chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /rtag par mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /dge kun gcig bsdus sems can don gyi phyir/ /bla med byang chub dam pa thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes byas kyang rung*/ de nas slar gsol 'debs cung zad rgyas pa byed na/ gong gi thub dbang rdo rje 'chang chen po sogs kyi phyag 'tshal de gsol 'debs su bsgyur nas lan gsum la sogs pa ci 'grub byas na legs mod/

bsdu na/ zla med ston pa thub dbang rdo rje 'chang*/ /rgyal tshab dam pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /spyan ras gzigs dang gsang ba'i bdag po sogs/ /nye sras mthu chen brgyad la gsol ba 'debs/ /shing rta che sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*/ yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /nyan rang 'phags tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ bstan srung chos skyong rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdo sngags brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*/ /mchog gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs bcas sogs/ /ji snyed skyabs su 'os pa thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so brtser dgongs byin gyis rlobs/ /ces bya'o/ /de gnyis gang byed kyang mjug tu byin rlabs zhu ba ni/ /skyabs gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis bdag 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las skyob tu gsol/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ khyad par du bdag gi rgyud la nges 'byung byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yang dag pa'i lta ba phyin drug bslab gsum rim gnyis la sogs pa mdo sngags kyi lam gyi rim pa khyad par can skye bar byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ gnas skabs su mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ phyi ma bde ba can nam/ dga' ldan du byams pa'i sras su skye bar byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ de'i slad du khyed rnams kyis sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas bdag la da lta nyid du byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum mam/ mang du brjod na legs/ yang na/ skyabs mgon dam pa 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gi 'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs zhi zhing*/ /mthun rkyen thams cad yin bzhin 'grub pa sogs/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /khyad par nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta/ /bslab gsum phyin drug rim gnyis ky-is bsdus pa'i/ /mdo sngags lung rtogs yon tan thams cad kyang*/ /bdag gi rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs ces bya'o/

/sngon ma ltar na/ zhes gsol ba btab pas skyabs gnas rnams kyi spyi bo mgrin pa thugs ka'i gnas gsum las 'od dang bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum rim pa bzhin du byung ste/ rang gi gnas gsum du rim pa bzhin du zhugs shing thim pas/ sgo gsum gyi nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad sbyangs nas sku gsum gyi go 'phang 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag skyabs gnas thams cad kyang 'od kyi rnam par gyur te rang gi snying khar thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ thub pa'i dbang po mos te snying po ci 'grub bzla zhing*/ der ma zad/ byams pa dang rigs gsum mgon po sogs lha gzhan dang gzhan du bsgyur nas de dang de'i sngags bzlas kyang legs shing*/ phyi ma la yang des chog mod/ tshigs bcad byed na/ de ltar gsol bas skyabs gnas thams cad kyi/ /gnas gsum dag las 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /dkar dmar mthing gsum rim dang cig car byung*/ /rang gi gnas gsum dag tu zhugs gyur pas/ /sgo gsum kun gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs byas te/ /sku gsum 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can/ /bzhag ste skyabs gnas thams cad bdud rtsi dang*/ /'od kyi rnam par rang gi snying khar thim/ /byin gyis brlabs pas rang nyid skad cig gis/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i skur gyur thugs ka ru/ /zla ba'i gdan steng muṃ yig ser po'i mthar/ /bzlas bya'i sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ /ces brjod de/ thub pa'i dbang po'i snying po sogs bzla/ 'od dpag med dang byams pa'i drung du skye bar 'dod na ni de gnyis kyi gzungs ring bzlas na legs so/ /de nas/ skye ba kun tu zhes sogs dang*/ dge ba 'di yis zhes sogs dang*/ dge 'dis mtshon nas zhes sogs bsngo smon ci rigs bya'o/ /mdo sngags gzhung don nyams len tshul/ /rnam grangs mang yang gnad bsdus pa'i/ /snying po tsam zhig rang blo la/ /shar tshod thogs med tshul du bris/

/ces nyams len gyi skor ji ltar bya ba'i tshul 'di ni/ sngar khya dge dgon gyi dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i dge tshul don yod blo gros dang*/ don yod rin chen rnam pa gnyis kyis 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul zhing*/ phyis g.yo sa'i dge slong grags pa dpal 'byor gyis kyang bskul ba'i ngor/ khri zur bshad sgrub ming can gyis rang lo don gnyis thog rang gi nyams len dang bstun nas co de'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā li la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ /'dis kyang gzhan rnams la phan thogs par gyur cig /mad+ga laṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/kun slong 'chos tshul sogs nyams len gyi skor bshad pa blo gsal dga' byed bzhugs/ -PAGE 88--PAGE 89--PAGE 70-
